subdivision_of_building: Front courtyard of 92a Balham High Road
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The permanent retention of the existing kiosks, by reason of their poor design and quality of build creating unkempt and visually intrusive additions, would result in a harmful impact to the character and appearance of the site and this section of Balham High Road. The development is therefore contrary to Policies PM8 and LP1 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 2 - The development includes kiosks operating as hot food takeaways and by reason of being within 400 metres of primary and secondary schools, would be contrary to the healthy initiatives aimed at promoting healthy lifestyles within neighbourhoods. The development is therefore contrary to paragraph 97 of the NPPF (2024), Policy E9(D) of the London Plan (2021) and Policy LP15(B) of the Local Plan (2023) and the Town Centre Uses SPD (2015).

Reason : 3 - In the absence of a Noise Management Plan and Cooking Odour Impact Assessment, it has not been demonstrated that the development would safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood. The development is therefore contrary to the London Plan (2021) and Policies LP2, LP14 and LP45 of the Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 4 - In the absence of an Operational Waste and Recycling Strategy, it has not been demonstrated that the development is an appropriate form of development at this location and would not be at risk of continued poor waste and recycling management to the detriment of this section of Balham town centre and nearby residents. The development is therefore contrary to the NPPF (2024), Policies PM8 (Balham) and LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the Reuse, Recycling and Waste (SPD) (2025).).

Reason : 5 - The submitted Fire Statement fails to demonstrate that suitable fire protection and mitigation methods are currently taking place at the existing kiosks and, in the absence of details to address these faults, thus fails meet fire safety requirements. Therefore, the use of the kiosks is unacceptable and contrary to policy D12 of the London Plan (2021).

Reason : 6 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to make available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
description: Erection of 7 x food kiosks in front courtyard.
